digest.component_or_area: reconciler transport port typing and static type checking
propositions: Core reconciler modules pass transport parameters without type annotations or with Any annotations, preventing mypy from enforcing port completeness and allowing backends to silently omit required members like set_entity_property.

Absolute imports via the rebar_reconciler.* shim path cause mypy to widen TicketTransport annotations to Any under ignore_missing_imports=true, even when the parameter is nominally typed, defeating static checking.

Relative imports from ._backend combined with proper TicketTransport annotations restore mypy's attribute-checking enforcement, catching missing capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) that the runtime AST audit cannot detect because they are metaclass-carried.

Four call sites require narrowed capability protocol views (SupportsComments, SupportsLinks) rather than bare TicketTransport to satisfy mypy's [attr-defined] checks, and none currently has a runtime guard against opt-in members.
